description: This file contains the implementation of the generic StreamImpl<T> class, which provides internal streaming functionality within the Orleans distributed virtual actor framework. It manages stream subscriptions, message handling, and lifecycle operations for a specific stream identified by stream ID. The class interacts with stream providers and handles serialization callbacks.

classes.name: StreamImpl<T>
classes.description: A sealed, internal implementation of an Orleans async stream, providing subscription management and message dispatching for a specific stream.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribes an observer or batch observer to the stream asynchronously.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up producer and consumer interfaces of the stream, optionally.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Sends an individual item onto the stream.

methods.name: OnNextBatchAsync
methods.description: Sends a batch of items onto the stream.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Signals that the stream has completed.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Signals an error on the stream.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a subscription handle with a new observer or batch observer.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptionHandles
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription handles for this stream.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes a specific handle from the stream.

methods.name: GetProducerInterface
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the producer interface for the stream.

methods.name: GetConsumerInterface
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the consumer interface for the stream.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the stream provider based on the stream ID's provider name.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this stream with another for ordering.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if this stream equals another stream.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the stream.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stream.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Handles deserialization callbacks, restoring runtime client context.
